about_the_game:
After escaping from the first layer of the Baldamar Dimension, Joshua discovers that he is in the mysterious Mafia base commanded by Salvatore Moretti. Unsure of how he got there, he must use stealth to infiltrate, silently eliminate guards and discover the secrets behind his sudden transition between dimensions.

In this non-canonical adventure, Joshua investigates the role of the Baldamar Mafia in the dimensional expeditions, revealing a web of conspiracies that involve the government itself and unknown entities. At the center of it all is the enigmatic Wendigo and the Mysterious Foxer, two creatures that followed him during his adventure there.

The mission culminates in a confrontation with Salvatore Moretti, where Joshua must face not only the strength of the Mafia, but also disturbing truths about the Baldamar Dimension and his own presence there. This DLC focuses on espionage, tactical combat and dark revelations, expanding the universe with a more political and criminal perspective.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains pretty gore and realistic gore, is not suitable for children under 16 years of age or sensitive people
